decision: Neither experiment is accepted. Native information-density noise scaling is substantially worse in 7 of 8 simulated pilot cases. Temporal guide changes fail the two natural-content pilots.

temporal_guide_manifest.method: signed RAW guide and cross-frame color covariance

limitations: Temporal prior fingerprint binds raw codes only; input report hash binds the complete diagnostic input.
Information-density scale is not a posterior marginal variance. Changing it without the prior weights changes smoothing strength.
Only partial development sets were used to reject these variants. Neither changes production defaults.
Natural-content scenes are simulated RAW, not real-scene truth.
